description: In Manager.io (Northwind Traders business), record a freight-in charge as a landed cost. Create a new Purchase Invoice for supplier 'Exotic Liquids'. Set the description to 'Freight charges for Chang shipment'. Add a line item selecting the inventory item 'Chang', set the Unit Price/Amount to 45.00, but leave the Quantity field BLANK (or set to 0). This allocates the cost to the item's value without increasing stock quantity. Save the invoice.
